review_candidates.title: AI 資料中心建置規劃經理（廠長級） AI Data Center Planning & Construction Manager / Head of DC Facilities
review_candidates.description: 【職務定位】 負責公司 AI 資料中心從零到上線的全生命週期，涵蓋選址評估、規劃設計、採購發包、工程建置、測試驗收、營運體系建立，以及後續擴建。須能獨立主導專案、對經營層提出投資與技術決策建議，並帶領內部團隊與外部設計顧問、統包（EPC）及機電廠商，打造高密度 GPU 運算環境，確保它穩定、可靠、節能且能持續擴充。 【主要工作內容】 一、選址評估與前期規劃 選址與盡職調查：評估電力取得性（台電供電容量、饋線及送電時程）、水源、土地與建物條件、樓板載重、地震與淹水風險，以及法規限制。 制定設計基準（Basis of Design）：訂出 IT 負載規模、機櫃密度（風冷／液冷混合，單櫃 30–150kW 以上）、備援等級（N+1／2N、Tier III／IV）、PUE／WUE 目標及分期擴建藍圖。 投資評估：試算 CAPEX／OPEX 與 TCO，建立每 MW 建置成本基準，評估自建或租用（Colocation），並向經營層提出決策建議。 二、設計審查與採購發包 主導設計顧問、建築師及 MEP／EPC 廠商，完成概念設計、基本設計及細部設計審查。 電力架構：高壓受電、主變壓器、中低壓配電、UPS／BESS、柴油發電機、匯流排槽及機櫃配電；審查短路、保護協調及電力品質分析。 冷卻架構：冰水主機、冷卻水塔／乾式冷卻器、CRAH／Fan Wall、液冷 CDU 及二次側管路（TCS），並與 GPU 平台廠商的參考架構需求對接。 消防（氣體滅火、預動式、VESDA）、門禁安全，以及 BMS／EPMS／DCIM 系統架構規劃。 制定長交期設備（變壓器、開關設備、發電機、UPS、冰機、CDU）的採購策略；主導招標、議價與合約管理。 三、工程建置與專案管理 統籌整體進度、預算、品質、工安及變更管理，協調土建、機電、IT 與網路之間的介面整合。 主導建照、使照、消防審查、用電申請等各項法規許可。 辨識專案風險（交期、供電、預算、技術）並擬定對策，定期向經營層報告。 四、測試驗收與上線移交 主導 Commissioning L1–L5、整合系統測試（IST）、假負載測試及全廠斷電測試（Black Building Test）。 追蹤缺失改善，完成竣工圖、設備清冊、操作手冊與教育訓練，確保如期達到可上線狀態（Ready for Service）。 五、營運體系建立與團隊管理 建立維運組織：人力配置、輪班制度、SLA 與 KPI。 建立 SOP／MOP／EOP、變更管理、CMMS 與備品策略，並管理維運廠商的履約表現。 追蹤 PUE、設備可用率與能耗，推動可靠度及節能改善；規劃年度預算與擴建計畫。 招募、帶領並培育資料中心工程及維運團隊。 【必要條件】 10 年以上資料中心、大型機房或科技廠務機電經驗，其中至少 5 年擔任經理、廠長或專案總監等管理職。 曾主導至少一座資料中心從規劃到上線的完整建置 （建議 IT 負載 5MW 以上，可依公司規模調整）。 專精供配電或冷卻空調其中一項，並深入了解另一項，具備跨系統整合判斷能力。 有管理設計顧問、EPC／統包廠商的經驗，並負責過數億元以上規模的工程預算。 熟悉台灣建築、消防、用電申請等法規與流程。 電機、機械、冷凍空調或相關工程科系大學以上。 英文能力可與國外原廠及客戶開會、閱讀技術文件與合約。 能配合重大工程節點及緊急事件支援。 【加分條件】 AI／HPC GPU 叢集（如 H100／B200／GB200 等級）的高密度液冷資料中心建置經驗。 Hyperscaler、大型雲端或主要 Colocation 業者的建置或營運經驗。 相關證照，例如 Uptime ATD／AOS、CDCP／CDCS／CDCE、電機技師、冷凍空調技師或 PMP。 儲能（BESS）、綠電採購（PPA）、熱回收等能源整合經驗。 多據點或海外資料中心建置經驗。 從零建立維運團隊與制度的經驗。

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Support Specialist - Bilingual French based in Canada . This role provides expert technical support to customers, partners, sales representatives, and internal teams across a fast-paced, technology-driven environment. You will troubleshoot complex hardware, software, connectivity, and platform issues involving connected vehicle technologies and integrated solutions. The position combines customer service excellence with technical problem-solving, requiring you to translate complex concepts into clear, practical guidance. You will manage support cases from initial contact through resolution while maintaining accurate documentation and protecting customer information. Working closely with technical teams and external partners, you will help resolve escalated issues involving devices, cameras, keyless systems, databases, and other integrations. The role also contributes to global initiatives and operates within a 24/7 support environment, offering opportunities to work with evolving technologies and diverse stakeholders. Accountabilities Provide responsive technical assistance to customers, partners, sales representatives, and internal teams through phone, chat, and email, ensuring a consistently positive support experience. Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues related to device connectivity, installation, network communications, platform configuration, and product implementation. Provide technical guidance on database setup, user management, rules and reporting, device errors, portal configuration, and other platform-related inquiries. Manage support cases from initial contact through resolution, documenting troubleshooting steps, solutions, and relevant technical information accurately. Collaborate with internal technical teams and external partners to investigate and escalate complex issues involving cameras, keyless systems, connected devices, and integrated technologies. Coordinate device and accessory returns and exchanges with the appropriate internal departments while ensuring timely resolution of customer concerns. Address customer complaints effectively, escalating critical issues to management when necessary while maintaining professionalism, empathy, and a solution-oriented approach. Protect the confidentiality and security of customer data and information while supporting broader strategic initiatives within the organization. Requirements Fluency in both English and French, with the ability to read, write, and communicate confidently in both languages in a professional environment. 1–3 years of experience in customer service or technical support, combined with 1–3 years of experience troubleshooting technical hardware and/or software issues. A post-secondary diploma or degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline is highly valued, while experience within a technical or engineering organization is considered an asset. Strong technical aptitude and analytical problem-solving skills, with working knowledge of programming languages such as SQL, Python, C#, or JavaScript highly valued. Experience with data warehouse technologies such as Google BigQuery is an advantage, along with strong proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables and report creation. Technical competence with Google Workspace tools such as Sheets, Docs, and Slides, combined with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and systems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers and users with varying levels of technical knowledge. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with customers, partners, and stakeholders across different levels of an organization. Highly organized and capable of managing multiple support cases, tasks, and projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail. Customer-focused, patient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-changing technology environment where responsibilities and priorities may evolve. Flexibility to work rotating schedules in a 24/7 support operation, including afternoons, evenings, overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays. Benefits Flexible working arrangements supporting both in-person and virtual collaboration. Home office reimbursement program to support effective remote work. Competitive medical and dental benefits for eligible full-time permanent employees. Retirement savings program. Baby bonus and parental leave top-up program. Online learning and networking opportunities to support professional growth. Electric vehicle purchase incentive program. A collaborative and inclusive work environment with opportunities to participate in online social events, networking activities, and professional development initiatives. Remote work support through cloud-based applications, collaboration tools, and asynchronous working practices. Employees working from home are expected to maintain a reliable internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload speeds. The position operates within a flexible hybrid model, with employees encouraged to use office facilities as often as they prefer. Full-time permanent employees are eligible for the benefits listed above. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: 风控体系管理高级经理（全面风险管理方向）
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 本岗位为全面风险管理体系模块的牵头角色，统筹负责集团全业态风险识别与分级、风险清单管理、内控体系顶层设计与运转评价、跨部门横纵协调推动等工作。需要候选人具备跨部门、跨组织横纵协调拉通推动的能力，能在风险理论和业务实务之间找到平衡，输出各方可接受的解决方案。 岗位职责： 1、对各业务板块（电力、贸易、新零售、生物质、城市燃气等）逐一梳理其风险维度，明确每个维度下的风险场景和触发条件。基于风险场景成因进行定性分类，区分客观风险与主观操作风险，明确各类风险的技防或人防管理方式。量化每个风险场景对集团的潜在损失影响，按影响程度和发生概率完成重要性等级分类。 2、输出各板块标准化风险清单，明确每类风险的管理边界和不可逾越的红线。将风险清单转化为各板块可执行的管理动作，与各职能部门和BG/BU进行深度沟通和二次校准，确保风险识别和分类结果贴合业务实际。对风险清单进行定期复核和动态更新，保持风险图谱的时效性。 3、统一制定并维护内控检查清单和内控手册体系，对内控检查清单进行重要性等级、管理方式和检查频次的分级分类。围绕制度可执行性、执行保障有效性、数字化程度、数据质量四个维度，对各职能部门和BG/BU的风险管理做独立评价。发现问题形成标准化清单，书面交付对应职能部门和BG/BU，整改进度持续跟踪，超期未完成升级预警，限期届满后现场验证闭环。 4、统筹推动各职能条口和业务主体落实风险管理要求，将风险识别成果和内控评价结论转化为各部门可理解可执行的管理改进方案。在多利益主体之间找到平衡点，避免体系工作沦为理论性的花架子或闭门造车。定期汇总体系评价结果和运转质量评估，识别体系性薄弱环节，输出体系运转质量报告。 5、持续跟踪同行业重大风险事件和监管政策变化，将外部风险信号纳入集团风险清单进行对照更新。利用AI工具批量完成风险动因归因、后果量化、技防人防判定和重要性等级分类，与各条口和业务主体逐一校准后输出各板块标准化风险管理战术地图。 任职要求： 1、985/211院校全日制本科及以上学历，风险管理、企业管理、财务、审计或相关专业。 2、7年以上企业全面风险管理、内控体系建设、内部审计、企业管理咨询或相关经验，有跨行业或集团型企业风险管理实操背景。 3、具备从0到1搭建企业风险管理体系或内控体系的实际经验，能独立完成风险识别、评估、分级和清单输出的全流程工作，以及内控检查清单和内控手册体系的搭建。 4、极强的跨部门沟通协调能力和横纵拉通推动能力，能在多利益主体之间找到平衡点，输出各方均可接受的解决方案。面对被评价方的抵触或争议时能坚持原则底线同时灵活调整策略。 5、具备数字化管理思维，能看懂、听懂各业务主体的数字化管理模式和系统运转逻辑，在此基础上对其管理效果做出准确评价。不要求精通建模，但要求能判断数字化手段是否真正管住了风险，而非形式上的系统上线。 6、具备AI工具与业务场景结合的主动探索能力，能在日常工作中自主发现AI赋能的切入点并推动落地，而非仅执行既定的AI应用指令。 7、具备丰富的业务实务经验，能将风险管理理论和内控评价标准与企业实际业务场景深度融合，避免方案流于形式。换位思考能力强，能从不同业务主体的视角理解其管理难点和诉求，制定切合实际的管理方案。 8、应变能力和抗压能力强，面对复杂局面和多方博弈时能保持清晰的逻辑判断和推进节奏。具备较强的主观能动性和独立工作能力，不依赖上级指令能自主发现问题并推动解决。
